rationale_one_line: Odysseus is a local-first, self-hosting AI agent workspace, so VoltAgent's deep-space command-terminal palette (near-black with emerald pulse) is the literal aesthetic, and MANIFESTO carries the bold anti-cloud, you-own-the-hardware declaration in PewDiePie's contrarian register.
writing_tone_notes: Irreverent, anti-corporate, declarative. Build-in-public peer voice. Bold short lines, color-burst punctuation. Contractions where natural. No superlatives; the no-cloud, your-hardware contrast carries the praise. Keep it about the work and the move, not the celebrity.
do_rules: Open on the project, not the fame; let the local-first stance be the hook.
Reserve the star-velocity metric for the X caption only; scenes stay qualitative.
Stay in the ownership metaphor: your hardware, your models, your data, no cloud.
Two flash beats in emerald for the stop-scroll; at least one orbit move.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the X caption.
No reuse of scene phrases (NO CLOUD, your machine, your models, it evolves, private by default) in the caption or Why-this-one.
No superlatives and no celebrity gushing; admire the build, not the subscriber count.
No framework repeat of RECEIPT (most recent on 2026-05-31).
